name: Rev. H. B. Schaffner
role: Dickinson clergyman; convicted of assault at Mandan, 1885
bio: The Rev. H. B. Schaffner of Dickinson preached Sunday evening sermons at the Medora roller rink in spring 1885, which the paper called eloquent, and in May he conducted a burial service. In August 1885 he was tried at Mandan and found guilty of assault with intent to do great bodily harm, with a sentence of six months in the penitentiary. In February 1886 the paper reported that he had left for Canada, and in August 1886 his bondsmen were ordered to pay his $1,000 bail after he was reported seen in Dickinson.
